responses.description: Returns a JSON object containing rule examples for the specified rule and language. The response includes a 'results' array with objects for correct and incorrect examples, each containing 'status' and 'sentence' fields, and for incorrect examples also a 'corrections' array. A warning message is included indicating this is not a public API.

Bad Request. Returned when required parameters are missing or invalid. Specifically, if 'lang' parameter is missing, if 'ruleId' parameter is missing, or if the HTTP method is not GET (ensureGetMethod throws IllegalArgumentException). The error message is included in the response body.
Not Found. Returned when the specified rule is not found for the given language. The error message includes the rule ID, language, and LanguageTool version information.
Internal Server Error. Returned when an unexpected exception occurs during processing, such as JSON generation errors or other runtime exceptions not explicitly caught.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to be checked. Either 'text' or 'data' must be provided, but not both.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON data containing the text or annotation to be checked. Either 'text' or 'data' must be provided, but not both.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language of the text, e.g. 'en-US' for American English or 'fr' for French. Use 'auto' for automatic language detection.

parameters.name: enabledRules
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of rule IDs to enable.

parameters.name: disabledRules
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of rule IDs to disable.

parameters.name: enabledCategories
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of category IDs to enable.

parameters.name: disabledCategories
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of category IDs to disable.

parameters.name: enabledOnly
parameters.description: If set to 'yes' or 'true', only the rules specified in enabledRules or enabledCategories will be used.

parameters.name: enableTempOffRules
parameters.description: If set to 'true', temporarily disabled rules will be enabled.

parameters.name: allowIncompleteResults
parameters.description: If set to 'true', the server may return incomplete results if the check takes too long or too many errors occur.

parameters.name: enableHiddenRules
parameters.description: If set to 'true', hidden rules (from a hidden matches server) will be enabled.

parameters.name: motherTongue
parameters.description: The mother tongue of the user, used for some rules.

parameters.name: preferredVariants
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of preferred language variants, e.g. 'en-GB,en-US'. Only allowed when language=auto.

parameters.name: preferredLanguages
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of preferred languages for language detection.

parameters.name: noopLanguages
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of languages to ignore during language detection. Only allowed when language=auto.

parameters.name: altLanguages
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of alternative languages to check against.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The checking mode. Must be one of 'textLevelOnly', 'allButTextLevelOnly', or 'all'.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The level of checking. Must be 'default' or 'picky'.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback function name. Must match [a-zA-Z]+.

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: Compact mode flag. If set to '1', the response will be more compact.

parameters.name: textSessionId
parameters.description: An identifier for the text session, used for A/B testing and caching.

parameters.name: useragent
parameters.description: The user agent string of the client, used for logging and A/B testing.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username for authentication. Requires either 'apiKey' or 'password'.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: API key for authentication. Requires 'username'.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for authentication. Requires 'username'.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT token for authentication, can be used to increase text length limits.

parameters.name: filterDictionaryMatches
parameters.description: If set to 'true', matches from the user's dictionary will be filtered out.

parameters.name: ruleValues
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of rule ID and value pairs, e.g. 'rule1:value1,rule2:value2'.

parameters.name: sourceText
parameters.description: Source text for bilingual checking. Requires 'sourceLanguage'.

parameters.name: sourceLanguage
parameters.description: Language of the source text for bilingual checking. Required when 'sourceText' is set.

parameters.name: multilingual
parameters.description: If set to 'true', enables multilingual checking using preferredLanguages.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Version of the client, used for logging.

parameters.name: inputLogging
parameters.description: If set to 'no', the input text will not be logged in case of errors.

responses.description: Successful check response containing rule matches as JSON.
Bad request: missing or invalid parameters, invalid language, invalid mode/level, invalid callback, invalid rule/category settings, or error rate too high.
Forbidden: access denied due to blocked referrer/origin, request limit exceeded, too many recent timeouts, or authentication failure.
Not found: unsupported action path.
Payload too large: text exceeds the maximum allowed length.
Internal server error: text checking took longer than the configured maximum time.
Service unavailable: too many parallel requests in the work queue.
